mapper.update: UPDATE macro_daily SET metric_value = #{record.metricValue}, metric_value2 = #{record.metricValue2}, mom_change = #{record.momChange}, source = #{record.source}, extra = #{record.extra}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE stat_date = #{record.statDate} AND indicator_code = #{record.indicatorCode}
